summary: Diff implements major frontend-only, fully local/deterministic upgrades to Fred: expanded static knowledge modules (cards, matchups, ladder/progression), improved deterministic matching/normalization and shorthand handling, and a new deterministic deck-list parser + structured deck review generator. Ask Fred UI intro/greeting and centralized disclaimer copy were updated to reflect expanded coverage and offline/deterministic stance.
